key_points: Michael Burry warns of potential AI write-offs for big tech including Amazon.
Goldman Sachs estimates hyperscalers need ~$300B AI revenue to break even on investments.
WSJ reports Amazon boosting robotics output with an Indiana factory.
Stocktwits notes Amazon announces multibillion-dollar data center expansion in Missouri.
Multiple institutional buyers increased holdings in AMZN (per MarketBeat filings).
